name: dbml-translator
description: Explain DBML to non-developers, diff against specs, draft developer questions, render Mermaid ERDs.

interface.shortDescription: Translate DBML schemas, diff them against product specs, and render Mermaid ERDs
interface.longDescription: Four skills that let a non-developer read a DBML schema and talk to engineers: dbml-explain (business narrative), dbml-spec-diff (PRD vs schema gaps), dbml-questions (prioritized questions to send a developer), dbml-to-mermaid (erDiagram for Confluence/README).
defaultPrompt: Explain this DBML schema for a non-developer
Find gaps between this DBML and the spec
Questions to ask a developer about this DBML
